abstract: Countries are accelerating actions to reduce food loss and waste to ensure global food security and sustainable development. Cooperatives are considered important channels for promoting the use of agricultural technologies and improving farmers' skills, which are regarded as key factors in reducing harvest losses. However, owing to data limitations, few systematic assessments of the effects of cooperative membership on food losses exist. On the basis of survey data from 703 maize growers in three major maize production areas in China, propensity score matching (PSM) and endogenous switching regression (ESR) were used in this study to evaluate the effects of cooperative membership on the maize harvest losses of households. The results revealed that membership significantly reduced maize harvest losses by 68%, saving farmers an average of 238.05 kg per ha, which is worth $91.92 per ha. Membership also contributed to minor pest attacks and better working attitudes during the harvest stage. Cooperative membership is critically important for China's food security, resource conservation, and environmental protection. If the average maize harvest loss reaches the level of loss observed among member households, then it is possible to meet the food consumption needs of 13.61 million people, saving 0.74 million ha of land and 0.29 million tons of fertilizer used for maize production and reducing carbon emissions by 4.04 million tons and the water footprint by 6.43 billion m 3 .
abstract_zh: 各国正加速行动减少粮食损失与浪费，以保障全球粮食安全与可持续发展。合作社被视为推广农业技术、提升农户技能的重要渠道，而这两者被认为是降低收获损失的关键因素。然而，受数据限制，关于合作社成员身份对粮食损失影响的系统性评估仍较为匮乏。本研究基于中国三大玉米主产区703户玉米种植户的调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）与内生转换回归（ESR）方法，评估合作社成员身份对农户玉米收获损失的影响。结果表明：成员身份显著降低了68%的玉米收获损失，平均每公顷为农户节省238.05公斤，折合每公顷91.92美元。此外，成员身份还有助于减少收获阶段的虫害侵袭，并改善农户的工作态度。合作社成员身份对中国粮食安全、资源节约与环境保护具有关键意义。若玉米平均收获损失降至成员农户的水平，则可满足1360万人的粮食消费需求，节省74万公顷土地及29万吨玉米生产用化肥，减少404万吨碳排放，并降低64.3亿立方米的水足迹。

abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is the largest federal nutrition assistance program in the United States, yet many eligible households do not participate due to administrative burdens, stigma, and geographic access constraints. We examine whether the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot (OPP), which allows beneficiaries to redeem benefits online, affects program participation. Using a difference‐in‐differences design with state‐level data from 2017 to 2021, we find that SNAP OPP increases program participation per capita by 13.7% (1.6 percentage points) and participation among individuals below the poverty line by 11.3% (11 percentage points). Event‐study estimates indicate effects emerge within three months and persist thereafter. Participation gains are larger in states with higher digital infrastructure (computer ownership and internet access) and greater vehicle access, indicating that online and physical access function as complements. States with higher shares of elderly residents and households with children also exhibit stronger responses. These findings suggest that enabling online benefit redemption can expand safety net access, though benefits vary systematically with local infrastructure and demographic composition.
abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国最大的联邦营养援助项目，但由于行政负担、污名化以及地理可达性限制，许多符合条件的家庭并未参与其中。我们考察了SNAP在线购买试点项目（OPP）——该试点允许受益人通过在线方式兑换福利——是否会影响项目参与率。利用2017年至2021年的州级数据，采用双重差分法进行分析，我们发现SNAP OPP使人均项目参与率提高了13.7%（1.6个百分点），贫困线以下个体的参与率提高了11.3%（11个百分点）。事件研究估计表明，该效应在三个月内显现并持续存在。在数字基础设施（计算机拥有率和互联网接入率）更完善以及车辆可及性更高的州，参与率增幅更大，这表明在线与实体可达性具有互补作用。老年居民比例较高以及有儿童家庭比例较高的州也表现出更强的响应。这些发现表明，允许在线福利兑换能够扩大安全网的可及性，但其效益会因当地基础设施和人口结构的差异而呈现系统性变化。
title: Online Benefit Redemption and SNAP Participation: Evidence From the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot

abstract: Unobserved objective output quality complicates the analysis of firm productivity and demand because higher‐quality products entail higher costs but offer greater consumption benefits. Using a panel of firms with output quality data, we decompose quantity‐based productivity into fundamental productivity and the costs of quality, and separate the demand residual into fundamental demand and quality benefits. Fundamental demand accounts for most revenue variation, whereas quality's revenue‐enhancing benefits are largely offset by its costs. During the 2008 global financial crisis, shifts in quality diverged from changes in fundamental productivity and demand, highlighting the role of quality in assessing firm and industry performance.
abstract_zh: 未观测到的客观产出质量使企业生产率与需求分析复杂化，因为更高质量的产品虽带来更高成本，却提供更大的消费效用。基于包含产出质量数据的企业面板数据，我们将基于数量的生产率分解为基础生产率与质量成本，并将需求残差分离为基础需求与质量收益。基础需求解释了大部分收入变动，而质量带来的收入提升效应在很大程度上被其成本所抵消。在2008年全球金融危机期间，质量变动与基础生产率及需求变化呈现分化态势，凸显了质量在评估企业与行业绩效中的关键作用。

abstract: We examine how pesticide expenditure relates to the probability distribution of yield and revenue per hectare in apple production in northern Italy. Using a flexible moment-based approach, we find that pesticide expenditure is negatively associated with downside risk in yield and revenue, whereas late frosts are positively associated with downside risk in yield. Sensitivity analyses show that mean-equation estimates are robust to unobserved confounders, while negative semi-variance models are less robust overall. Only the pesticide–expected outcome relationship appears plausibly causal. Therefore, conclusions about pesticides as risk-increasing or risk-decreasing inputs should be made with caution.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部苹果生产中农药支出与每公顷产量及收益概率分布之间的关系。采用灵活的基于矩的方法，我们发现农药支出与产量和收益的下行风险呈负相关，而晚霜则与产量的下行风险呈正相关。敏感性分析表明，均值方程估计对未观测到的混杂因素具有稳健性，而负半方差模型整体稳健性较弱。只有农药与预期结果之间的关系似乎具有合理的因果性。因此，关于农药作为风险增加或风险减少投入的结论应谨慎得出。
title: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
title_zh: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系

abstract: Abstract While international knowledge transfer drives structural transformation, the diffusion of tacit knowledge—the complex skills and procedures essential for sophisticated production—remains constrained by the need for face-to-face interaction. This paper identifies outbound business travel as a distinct channel for overcoming this friction. Exploiting a panel of 113 countries (1995–2020) and a System GMM framework to address endogeneity, I document a robust positive association between business travel and economic complexity. I show that this relationship is conditional on domestic political institutions: the returns to travel are amplified in inclusive, open political environments but vanish in highly centralized systems. Furthermore, I find evidence of diminishing marginal returns, suggesting that the benefits of travel moderate as connectivity channels saturate. I conclude that inclusive institutions function as a critical “absorptive filter” mechanism, enabling the tacit knowledge acquired abroad to translate effectively into national productive capabilities.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际知识转移推动着结构性转型，但隐性知识——复杂生产所需的关键技能与流程——的传播仍受限于面对面互动的需求。本文指出，出境商务差旅是克服这一摩擦的独特渠道。基于113个国家1995-2020年的面板数据，并采用系统GMM框架处理内生性问题，本文证实商务差旅与经济复杂度之间存在稳健的正向关联。研究表明，这一关系受国内政治制度调节：在包容开放的政治环境中，差旅的回报效应被放大，但在高度集权体制下则完全消失。此外，本文发现边际回报递减的证据，表明随着连通渠道趋于饱和，差旅收益将逐步减弱。结论指出，包容性制度作为关键的"吸收过滤"机制，能够使海外获取的隐性知识有效转化为国家生产能力。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
title_zh: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性

abstract: This paper examines whether traditional gender norms are associated with well-being penalties for the rising share of women who are more educated than their husbands (hypogamy). Using panel data from the Japanese Panel Survey of Consumers (JPSC) covering the period of 1993 to 2020, the results show that women in hypogamous marriages report lower life satisfaction than other married women. The negative association is less pronounced for more recent marriage cohorts, as well as for women with less traditional norms. Moreover, the association shows stronger negative well-being implications for hypogamous women whose intra-household role is not in line with norm-based expectations.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了传统性别规范是否与日益增多的“妻强夫弱”（即妻子受教育程度高于丈夫）婚姻中女性的幸福感损失相关。基于1993年至2020年日本消费者面板调查（JPSC）的面板数据，结果显示，处于“妻强夫弱”婚姻中的女性报告的生活满意度低于其他已婚女性。这种负向关联在较晚近的婚姻队列中以及传统观念较弱的女性中不那么显著。此外，对于家庭内部角色不符合规范预期的“妻强夫弱”女性，这种关联表现出更强的负面幸福感影响。

abstract: This paper examines whether the Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax reduces bank profitability and regulatory capital, and for which banks the effects are strongest. We use a quarterly exposure-based difference-in-differences design around 2024Q1, where treatment intensity is defined by pre-2024 low-tax exposure among in-scope banks. The analysis uses a quarterly bank-level panel for 2014–2024 and exploits predetermined cross-sectional heterogeneity in low-tax exposure while controlling for bank and quarter fixed effects. The headline estimates show that post-2024 profitability and capital buffers decline more for high-exposure banks: profit after tax falls by about 2.2 basis points of assets per quarter and Tier 1 buffers by about 0.09 percentage points in the baseline specification. Higher low-tax exposure is not interpreted as vulnerability per se. The downside channel is concentrated where high pre-reform low-tax exposure coincides with limited initial capital headroom: event-study, placebo, matched-sample, and split-sample evidence all point to larger post-2024 capital-buffer compression for thin-buffer banks. Overall, the results indicate modest average effects but meaningful tail risk for banks that combine high minimum-tax exposure with thin initial capital buffers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了支柱二全球最低税是否降低了银行盈利能力和监管资本，以及哪些银行受到的影响最为显著。我们采用基于季度暴露水平的双重差分设计，以2024年第一季度为政策节点，将受覆盖银行在2024年前的低税暴露程度定义为处理强度。分析基于2014-2024年银行层面季度面板数据，利用预先确定的低税暴露截面异质性，同时控制银行和季度固定效应。主要估计结果显示，2024年后高暴露银行的盈利能力和资本缓冲下降幅度更大：在基准设定中，税后利润每季度下降约2.2个基点（以资产计），一级资本缓冲下降约0.09个百分点。较高的低税暴露本身并不被解读为脆弱性。其负面传导渠道集中于改革前低税暴露较高且初始资本缓冲空间有限的银行：事件研究、安慰剂检验、匹配样本和分样本证据均表明，资本缓冲薄弱的银行在2024年后资本缓冲压缩幅度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明平均效应温和，但对于初始资本缓冲薄弱且面临较高最低税暴露的银行而言，存在显著的尾部风险。

abstract: We study optimal nonlinear income taxation when productivity depends negatively on labor supply (labor-supply-dependent productivity, LSDP). Relative to a benchmark model with fixed productivities, we find that LSDP leads to higher optimal marginal tax rates, especially for higher-income individuals, and greater redistribution. The key mechanism is that, under LSDP, marginal taxation becomes a more effective screening instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当生产率与劳动供给呈负相关（即劳动供给依赖型生产率，LSDP）时的最优非线性所得税问题。与生产率固定的基准模型相比，我们发现LSDP会导致更高的最优边际税率，尤其是对高收入群体而言，并带来更强的再分配效应。其关键机制在于，在LSDP条件下，边际税收成为一种更有效的筛选工具。

abstract: The Borda count offers a promising alternative to counteract the growing polarization of party systems by incentivizing moderate party strategies. However, empirical evidence on the Borda count is still lacking. This paper presents results from an online survey conducted in the aftermath of the 2025 German federal election, in which respondents were asked for their vote choice under a Borda count system. Participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: in the first, they could rank up to three out of seven parties; in the second, they could rank all seven parties. The findings show that more ranks considered, the more fragmented the election result. It also shows that the Borda count has mixed effects on policy congruence between voters and parliament. Respondents’ overall acceptance of the Borda rule was moderate to negative, with many of the objections cited were based on misconceptions about the system’s consequences.
abstract_zh: 波达计数法通过激励政党采取温和策略，为应对政党体系日益加剧的两极分化提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，关于波达计数法的实证证据仍然匮乏。本文基于2025年德国联邦大选后开展的一项在线调查，呈现了受访者在波达计数法下的投票选择结果。参与者被随机分配到两种情境之一：第一种情境中，他们最多可对七个政党中的三个进行排序；第二种情境中，他们可对所有七个政党进行排序。研究结果表明，可排序的政党数量越多，选举结果越分散。同时，波达计数法对选民与议会之间的政策一致性产生了混合效应。受访者对波达规则的整体接受度处于中等偏负面水平，且许多反对意见源于对该制度后果的误解。

abstract: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. Using the universe of firms in Hungary, we show that removing capital controls lowers firms’ cost of capital and increases household consumption, with the latter playing a dominant role. The consumption channel leads to reallocation of resources toward high expenditure elasticity activities – such as services – promoting both the expansion of incumbents and firm entry. A multi-sector heterogeneous firm model replicates these dynamics. Our model shows that non-homotheticity in consumption can quantitatively account for the reallocation of resources towards services and successfully replicates the dynamics of aggregate productivity following episodes of financial openness.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实证与理论研究国际金融流动对资源配置的影响。利用匈牙利全部企业数据，我们发现取消资本管制降低了企业的资本成本并增加了家庭消费，其中消费渠道起主导作用。消费渠道导致资源向高支出弹性活动（如服务业）重新配置，既促进了现有企业的扩张，也推动了新企业进入。一个多部门异质性企业模型复现了这些动态变化。我们的模型表明，消费中的非位似性能够从数量上解释资源向服务业重新配置的现象，并成功复现了金融开放后全要素生产率的动态变化。
title: The Micro and Macro Dynamics of Capital Flows
title_zh: 资本流动的微观与宏观动态

abstract: We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the nineteenth century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time–and thus monitoring costs–between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中央机构降低监控成本的技术如何塑造了从小型世袭国家向大型官僚组织的历史转型。我们的分析基于一个新颖的数据集，该数据集追踪了19世纪美国联邦政府组织结构与地理分布的变化。为识别因果效应，我们开发了一种新的识别策略，利用铁路网络的扩张作为华盛顿特区与其他地点之间旅行时间（即监控成本）变化的来源。我们提出三项主要发现：第一，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的缩短显著增加了联邦政府在某一地点设立机构的可能性；第二，这种效应在代理问题更严重的职业和任务中更为显著；第三，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的减少与当地联邦政府世袭特征的减弱相关，这与监控能力增强减少了对个人信任和关系依赖的结论一致。
title: State Capacity as an Organizational Problem
title_zh: 组织能力作为一个组织问题

abstract: Business dynamism -- the process of firm entry, growth and exit -- lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms' customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.
abstract_zh: 商业活力——企业进入、成长与退出的过程——是现代内生增长模型的核心。尽管生产率差异传统上被视为商业活力的主要驱动力，但越来越多的证据表明，客户获取至少同样重要。基于这一证据，我们提出了一种新颖的内生增长模型，其中创新企业必须首先获取客户才能销售其产品。通过使用总体数据和企业层面数据估计该模型，我们发现企业客户基础（市场规模）的扩张会增强其创新激励，并将资源转向高增长企业（“瞪羚企业”）。综合来看，这些效应解释了超过40%的总体增长，并显著改变了关于增长政策有效性的预测。最后，我们利用企业层面微观数据为模型的关键预测提供了支持证据。
title: Customer Acquisition, Business Dynamism and Aggregate Growth
title_zh: 客户获取、商业活力与总体增长

abstract: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyze the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商在塑造竞争中的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，随后企业在差异化产品市场中展开伯特兰式竞争。我们分析了最大化消费者剩余和生产者剩余的信息设计，揭示了信息在强化或缓和竞争方面可被系统性运用的差异。我们的分析表明，用户数据能够赋予中间商巨大力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管辩论。
title: Market Segmentation through Information
title_zh: 基于信息分割的市场细分

abstract: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer's utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyze mergers. We analyze how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually-negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.
abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，买家在差异化产品之间进行离散选择，并协商与选择相关的特定价格。我们针对这类市场开发了一个用于估计的模型，该模型与买家与竞争卖家之间非合作议价模型保持一致。我们证明，当买家效用具有广义极值（GEV）扰动时，该模型具有易于处理的似然函数，可结合提供所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据进行使用。我们利用英国砖业行业的数据对该模型进行估计，并以此衡量市场势力及分析并购。我们研究了空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响交易间市场势力的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现从单独协商定价转向统一定价会导致平均加成率及并购价格效应上升，但少数交易的加成率及并购价格效应反而下降。
title: Competition in a Spatially-Differentiated Product Market with Negotiated Prices
title_zh: 谈判价格下的空间差异化产品市场竞争

abstract: We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项实地实验，向无银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，以考察缺乏经验的消费者如何学习使用新型金融技术。研究发现，接触工资账户能提升账户使用率、加速学习进程，并帮助规避常见的消费者保护风险。接受电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立起对该技术的信任，学会独立使用账户，并避免支付非法费用。通过实验性分配银行账户与移动货币账户的差异，我们证明这些影响主要集中在移动货币账户上——这是一种更新颖、更复杂且信任度较低的金融技术。
title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
title_zh: 学习驾驭新型金融技术

abstract: We employ a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with ordinal outcomes to study efficiency in producing overall life satisfaction. Inefficiency is specified as an unknown function of discrete characteristics using a nonparametric Nadaraya–Watson estimator. A Bayesian procedure is developed to estimate latent variables and model parameters, including the bandwidths of the nonparametric component. The empirical analysis examines the role of the Big Five personality traits and individual resilience, showing that individuals who are more extraverted, agreeable, conscientious, and resilient, or less neurotic, tend to be more efficient in converting satisfaction across multiple life domains into overall life satisfaction.
abstract_zh: 本文采用含有序结果的半参数随机前沿模型，研究整体生活满意度的生产效率。通过非参数Nadaraya–Watson估计量，将无效率项设定为离散特征的未知函数。我们开发了贝叶斯程序来估计潜变量和模型参数，包括非参数部分的带宽。实证分析考察了大五人格特质与个体韧性的作用，结果表明：更外向、更随和、更尽责、更具韧性或神经质程度较低的个体，在将多个生活领域的满意度转化为整体生活满意度方面往往更有效率。
title: Efficiency in producing life satisfaction: A stochastic frontier analysis
title_zh: 生活满意度生产效率：随机前沿分析
